A '''lightning rod''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds [[Stonecutter]] recipes for the 8 variants below, and otherwise leaves them as in vanilla. See {{MCW|Lightning Rod}} for everything else.
